name: i die a lovely life
source:
Long distance girlfriends Uni and Nuña are aching to meet, but neither of them can afford the plane tickets. Willing to do anything for money, Uni participates in a research study to have her brain uploaded into a computer...

[From [url=https://nezita.itch.io/dll]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
远距离女友尤尼和努娜渴望见面，但她们都买不起机票。为了钱愿意做任何事，Uni参加了一项研究，将她的大脑上传到电脑中……
